about: The AP Chemistry app pages. scripts/build-apchem.mjs writes each page's shell (head, header, footer, a <div id="app"> mount) from this file; the page's behavior is its script in chem/assets/<script>, which mounts into #app. Until that script exists the shell says the page arrives with the first published unit. "static": true marks a generated page that is not an app (teachers.html). premium names the Premium feature (ApChemCore gates it); card is the line on the course home. No path may contain the token "ap" (docs/apchem-spec.md decision 2). tools[] are the trainers, skills tools and drills: page chem/tools/<slug>.html, script chem/assets/tools/<slug>.js, content chem/data/tools/<slug>.json (docs/apchem-architecture.md, Tools). Free or Premium per tool: the first tool of each unit (in the map's order) and every skills tool are free, as in AP® Biology; the rest carry "premium": "tools" (docs/apchem-spec.md decision 15).

apps.title: Practice questions
apps.desc: Chemistry practice by unit, topic or skill: stimulus sets and calculations graded on value, units and significant figures, with every option explained.
apps.card: Drill a unit, a topic or a science practice, with stimulus sets.

apps.title: Spaced review
apps.desc: Your chemistry spaced review queue: every question you missed comes back just before you would forget it.
apps.card: Missed questions come back when you are about to forget them.

apps.title: Unit tests and practice exams
apps.desc: Timed chemistry unit tests and full practice exams in the real format: 60 multiple-choice questions in 90 minutes, then 7 free-response questions.
apps.card: Unit tests and full timed practice exams in the real 60 + 7 format.

apps.title: Free-response practice
apps.desc: Chemistry free-response practice, long and short questions, each with a point-by-point rubric, a full-credit sample answer and a printable answer sheet.
apps.card: Long and short free-response questions, with rubrics and sample answers.

apps.title: Cram kit
apps.desc: Chemistry cram plans counted back from your exam date: three or two weeks, day by day, weighted by unit, with unit sheets, timed mixed sets and practice exams.
apps.lede: A 3-week or 2-week plan counted back from your exam date, day by day: unit sheets and notes, a timed mixed set and one free-response question each study day, two full practice exams and rest days. Print it and tick the days off.
apps.card: 3-week and 2-week plans to exam day, and timed mixed sets.

apps.title: Flashcards
apps.desc: Spaced-repetition chemistry flashcards built from the glossary, by unit and topic.

apps.title: Trainers and drills
apps.desc: Chemistry trainers and drills: justifications, particle diagrams, equilibrium and buffer drills, titration curves, each followed by questions.
apps.card: Trainers and drills, then the questions about what you did.

apps.title: Your dashboard
apps.desc: Your chemistry mastery by unit, topic and science practice, with every miss linked to the lesson that teaches it.
apps.card: Mastery by unit, topic and science practice.

apps.title: Search the course
apps.desc: Search every chemistry lesson, notes page, glossary term and tool in the course.

apps.title: For teachers
apps.desc: For chemistry teachers: stable share links, printable notes and unit sheets, and sharing pages to Google Classroom, with no new student data collected.
apps.lede: Share any notes page, lesson or unit sheet with a stable link. Students need no account, and nothing they do leaves their device unless they choose to sign in.

tools.name: Particle diagrams
tools.title: Particle diagram trainer
tools.desc: Choose the right particle picture: water around ions, limiting reactants, equilibrium counts, and strong against weak acids, with feedback on each wrong one.
tools.blurb: Water around ions, limiting reactants, equilibrium counts and acid strength, drawn particle by particle.

tools.name: ICE table drills
tools.title: ICE table drills
tools.desc: Unlimited ICE table problems: find K, find equilibrium amounts with small x and the 5% check, and perfect squares, checked row by row.
tools.blurb: Build the I, C and E rows step by step; every slip gets its own feedback.

tools.name: Q vs K
tools.title: Q vs K trainer
tools.desc: Calculate Q from concentrations, pressures or a particle picture, compare it with K, predict the shift and pick the justification that earns the point.
tools.blurb: Q from numbers or particles, the direction of the shift, and the wording that earns the point.

tools.name: Titration curve reader
tools.title: Titration curve reader
tools.desc: Read titration curves computed from the equilibrium math: equivalence and half-equivalence points, pKa, indicator choice and the species present.
tools.blurb: Equivalence, half-equivalence and pKa, indicator choice and the species at each point.

tools.name: Buffer and Henderson-Hasselbalch drills
tools.title: Buffer and Henderson-Hasselbalch drills
tools.desc: Unlimited buffer problems: Henderson-Hasselbalch pH, the ratio for a target pH, added strong acid or base, and capacity, with feedback on ln and log.
tools.blurb: Buffer pH, target ratios, added acid or base and capacity, checked step by step.

tools.name: Units and significant figures
tools.title: Units and significant figures checker
tools.desc: Calculation habits graded on value, units and significant figures: J and kJ, Celsius and kelvin, the right R, and the rules for multiplying and adding.
tools.blurb: Value, unit and significant figures graded separately, with a note on every slip.
